column1: # Curated calibration-free line list for REE minerals measured by LIBS in air (LIGHTIGO
# spectrometer, 188.6-859.1 nm).  Standard LIBS / ICP-OES analytical lines of the matrix,
# volatile, ambient-air and rare-earth elements, each matched to external_data/Source/LIBS_data.db
# (element, stage, |dlambda| <= 0.02 nm; strongest gk*Ak on ties).  All values are copied from
# that DB: AIR wavelengths [nm], energies [eV], Ak [1/s].  Gd II, Sm II, Ho II lines come from the
# Wisconsin laboratory data added by scripts/augment_line_db.py (NIST ASD has no Aki for them).
# Forced into the cf_isolated line dictionary (config/line_embedding_cf*.yaml, flagged forced=1);
# isolation_score and the CF weights decide how much each line is trusted.  Resonance lines are
# kept but flagged: they are the most sensitive lines of trace elements but self-absorb at major
# Candidates NOT in LIBS_data.db (no Aki in NIST ASD or the laboratory data): La II 333.749, Ce II 413.380, Ce II 418.660, Pr II 390.844.
# Replaces cf_oes_lines_54.tsv (steel, vacuum) for this project.
